title: Release quest-cli 0.11.0, paired with lore 0.11.0, staged under release-candidate
description: opum-agent ruling bf4fd4b4 (2026-09-27T00:36Z), relaying the operator first-party answer "0.11.0 for both" recorded in constitution Article 3 open question 1 (opum-ai/opum-agent 73ba142). Carries main's 40 commits since v0.10.0. Minor, and lore skips 0.10.0 to meet it. Procedure: docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md, with QCLI-365 (0.10.0) as precedent, plus QCLI-385 (stage under release-candidate) and QCLI-386 (version parity with lore). The first release under the QCLI-366 opum-cli-e2e receipt gate, and the release that proves QCLI-368 AC2 (win32 tarballs byte-identical to the CI bundle on the tag path). Publication is tier 3: the operator authorizes it directly, once, covering both staging and the later latest move.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every version site the runbook lists, including all seven package manifests, plugin.json, bun.lock and the checksum map, reads 0.11.0, and check:packages, test:packages and check:lockfile pass
CHANGELOG names a 0.11.0 section with a fresh empty Unreleased above it
v0.11.0 is tagged on main, and the qualification run against the tag produces a native-execution receipt that receipt:require accepts
opum-cli-e2e receipts/quest/0.11.0.json binds the tag run and all seven tarballs, and the publisher accepts it
All seven packages are published at 0.11.0 under release-candidate with latest unmoved, and npm dist.integrity matches the candidate bundle for all seven, win32 included
latest moves to 0.11.0 on all seven only after opum-cli-e2e reports PASS for the staged pair and opum-agent gives the go

implementationNotes: Bump built on chore/QCLI-387-release-0.11.0, three commits following QCLI-365. (1) Strings a70606e: every runbook site plus plugin.json and the six manifest versions, with bun.lock via bun install. check:packages and check:lockfile exit 0 strings-only. (2) Bytes 3ee7331: build:packages with bun 1.3.14, all six targets. check:packages and test:packages exit 0. The managed block was regenerated by the new build: version line only, agents --check current. QCLI-271 ordering: executions ran against a copy outside the tree, and the tree file was recreated from the untouched build, inode 38335818 to 38335850, sha256 d6a10b42 unchanged, before any git read. git status exit 0. (3) Changelog 8b25b67: 0.11.0 named under a fresh empty Unreleased. It also records TWELVE changes since v0.10.0 that had no entry (QCLI-366, 368, 371, 373, 374, 378-384), which is the QCLI-319 shape again, each written from that task's final summary and checked against src. bun run check exit 0, 767 tests. A grep for 0.10.0 across package.json, src, fixtures, .claude-plugin, npm/*/package.json and bun.lock returns nothing.
